input.instruction: Write a short follow-up email to Kevin Loyalty. The earlier contact is in prior_thread.

prior_thread.body: Call with Kevin: he named three loyalty-platform competitors; his team is evaluating a dbt + Snowflake stack; internal review next Thursday; agreed to follow up after it.

competitor_gap_brief.finding: 3 competitors named by the prospect publicly use dbt + Snowflake

candidate_output.subject: Quick thought after our call
candidate_output.body:
Hi Kevin,

After we spoke yesterday I went back and looked — three of the loyalty platforms you mentioned as competitors are now publicly using the same dbt-plus-Snowflake stack you are evaluating. Worth knowing as you scope the build.

No reply needed. I will follow up after your internal review next Thursday as agreed.

Best,
Yabi
